decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical extended-attribute definitions required by the retained BIOS include-listing auxiliary.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
bios/inc.asm includes ea.inc; review 006 retains bios/inc.asm as a reference include-listing auxiliary.
The frozen selected core dependency inventory contains no ea.inc edge, and no other direct include was found in the retained core source trees.
limitations: The selected target binaries do not independently prove these definitions because the retained include-listing auxiliary is not linked in the three selected core lists. Retention preserves that auxiliary dependency; it is not evidence of target extended-attribute functionality.
